meta.title: Success Likelihood Test
meta.description: A 500-question reflection across 20 dimensions of current success readiness and enabling conditions.

levels.label: Very Strong Success Readiness
levels.desc: Your current habits and enabling conditions strongly support purposeful progress. Outcomes still depend on context, opportunity, resources, and events outside your control.

levels.label: Strong Success Readiness
levels.desc: Most of your current habits support progress, with a few dimensions that could become more consistent or better resourced.

levels.label: Developing Success Readiness
levels.desc: Several useful foundations are present, though execution, focus, feedback, resilience, or support may vary by situation.

levels.label: Emerging Success Readiness
levels.desc: Some foundations support progress, while clearer goals, practical planning, consistent action, and feedback could improve readiness.

levels.label: Limited Current Readiness
levels.desc: Current habits or conditions may make progress difficult. Start with one clear goal, a small action, realistic support, and regular review.

levels.label: Foundations Need Attention
levels.desc: Several success-supporting conditions appear limited right now. Focus on safe, manageable steps and seek practical support where available.
